messages:
Zoe (CEO): quick ask post-all-hands  need one-sentence partner-friendly status + the single biggest risk for API / Console / Optimize. Paste by EOD.

Mara (Product): API: limited preview next week  benefit: stronger auth and more consistent SDKs. Biggest risk: auth v2 rollout may impact long-lived connections on dedicated infra.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirmed. We'll do a 10% canary and monitor connection resets; rollback plan ready.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in canary for route analytics and a cleaner onboarding flow in June. Biggest risk: telemetry schema v2 needs cross-team sign-off (docs + SDK).

Alex (Optimize): Optimize: preview for automated batching + cache recommendations to cut per-token cost. Biggest risk: customers may require an explicit opt-out for auto-suggestion UX. Filing a ticket.

Sam (Docs): I'll produce partner-friendly bullets + a short FAQ (opt-in/opt-out) by tomorrow morning and link PR here.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: the auth switch includes a routing sync that could surface as brief reconnections (1-3 min) for some long-lived streams; zero-blip approach not fully proven yet.

Ops (Release): Please tag release tickets FINAL_SIGNOFF by Thu 17:00 UTC so we can lock canary windows and notify customers.

Comm (Marketing): I'll draft the partner blurb once Sam posts final copy. Keep messaging benefits-first and non-technical.

Mara (Product): Partner-friendly one-liners (benefits-first):
- API: "Preview: improved security and more consistent SDKs to simplify integrations."
- Console: "Preview: opt-in route insights to help teams measure performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: suggested batching and cache tips to reduce inference cost without changing outputs."

Zoe (CEO): Good. Sam, tag me when copy is ready and I'll send to partners. If canary validation fails, post here immediately. :thumbsup:
